description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Triplicate Titan with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Triplicate Titan token, adding {C}{C}.
The token Triplicate Titan dies, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Golems, untapping Mimic Vat.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Golem, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
